Pakistan ke Punjab mein sthit Gojra ek aisa shehar hai jahan aaj bhi 1947 aur Partition ki yaadein zinda nazar aati hain.
Is vlog mein hum Jhang aur Toba Tek Singh se safar karte hue Gojra pahunche. Raaste mein humne dekha Noorpur Railway Station, jo British era ka ek bahut hi purana railway station hai. Iske baad humne explore kiya Gojra Railway Station, purane Hindu-Sikh ghar, purana mandir, Sanatan Dharam Bhavan, local bazaar, sabzi mandi aur Gojra ki mashhoor barfi.
